name: Citation Audit
description: Audit an existing document's claims against its citations and report every mismatch: a reviewer pairs each cited claim with the citation it depends on and locks the audit rubric, a researcher opens each cited source and verifies the claim is actually supported, and a reviewer compiles a per-citation audit report with verdicts and fixes. The ordering matters because auditing without first pairing claims to citations misses unsupported claims, and a report without a fixed verdict scale is inconsistent; building the claim-citation pairing and rubric first makes the audit exhaustive and the report actionable. Use this for checking that citations support their claims, source-verification of a draft, catching citation drift or unsupported statements, and 'do these references actually back up the text' reviews.
